description: Read-only. Deals specific, buildable page mechanics from Layoza's catalogue: 1 hero + `count` section mechanics (2 `signature` to build verbatim in spirit, the rest `suggestions`) + 1 transition, never two of one mechanism family, deterministic per `seed`. Each entry has a blueprint (clamp() sizes, states), scroll-progress motion, still_check, mobile, a11y, avoid and CSS/JS paths. New sites (`new_website`, `full_redesign`): the brief drives niche, mood and intensity. Existing sites (`extend_existing`, `improve_existing`): the site's motion language caps intensity and stack (from `existing_motion_intensity`, or by inspecting `path`), so nothing dealt restyles the site. Mechanics built around another trade's object are excluded; `fit` gives each dealt mechanic's fit class and reason.

avoid.description: Mechanic ids used recently (e.g. on the last projects); never dealt again.

brief.description: The page brief, e.g. `neighbourhood bakery with a daily bread board`.

existing_motion_intensity.description: Existing site's motion dial (0-3 calm, 4-7 bold, 8-10 wild). Without it, an existing-site deal inspects `path`.

intensity.description: Motion tier. New site: used only when the brief names none. Existing site: may only lower the site's own level.

mood.description: Optional comma-separated moods (calm, warm, playful, bold, luxe, technical, editorial, organic, brutal, dark, bright, trustworthy, experimental, minimal).

niche.description: Optional niche hint (store, restaurant, local-business, saas, dashboard, agency, kinetic, 3d, editorial, portfolio, finance, health, education, events, real-estate, travel, nonprofit, docs, landing, professional, devtools); added after niches the brief names.

path.description: Project-relative path (file or directory) inside the approved project root; defaults to '.'.

seed.description: Deterministic seed; defaults to a hash of the brief.

name: deal_mechanics
